diagnostics.notes: Elevation crossings refined by bisection; peaks by golden-section search. Half-open search interval [start, end). Below-threshold intervals count as covered only when a Lipschitz rate bound proves them invisible; unprovable brackets are bisected down to the 1 us reporting resolution to expose hidden crossings, and whatever stays unresolvable (grazing contacts) is reported in uncovered_intervals instead of being silently skipped.
